description: This file defines an Angular component named FooterComponent which provides footer functionalities for a Todo application, including displaying todo counts, filtering, and clearing completed items.

classes.name: FooterComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing the footer section of a Todo app, handling display logic for todo counts, filters, and actions.

methods.name: todos
methods.description: Returns all Todo items from the TodosService.

methods.name: activeTodos
methods.description: Returns active Todo items filtered via TodosService.

methods.name: completedTodos
methods.description: Returns completed Todo items filtered via TodosService.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Gets the current filter status from the URL path, defaulting to 'all'.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Triggers clearing of completed Todo items via the service.
